meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 让 Claude 按 HyperFrames 流程创建或编辑视频合成:先检查更新,加载媒体/设计适配器,根据项目状态(如 BRIEF.md)决定动作,再分阶段制定计划、构建场景并导出。
howto.when: 当没有专门工作流适合,或 BRIEF.md 设置 flow 为 companion 时触发;也用于长视频、多场景短片、品牌宣传片等创作。

say.text: 帮我制作一个30秒的品牌宣传片,主题是新品发布。
say.note: 会启动 general-video 流程,先生成计划再制作。

say.text: 把这段素材剪成多场景的蒙太奇。
say.note: 会按 HyperFrames 多场景合成规则处理。

say.text: 我想要一个静态标题卡,风格简洁。
say.note: 会使用 general-video 的静态构图流程。

howto.what_en: Makes Claude create or edit HyperFrames video compositions: checks updates, loads media/design adapters, acts on project state (BRIEF.md), then plans, builds scenes, and exports in stages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion; also for long-form, multi-scene, brand reels, etc.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand reel about the new product launch.
say_en.note: Starts the general-video flow, planning before building.
